'''Snit''' was a [[Dewback/Legends|dewback]] owned by the Calwell family on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. He was taken care by [[Kallie Calwell]]. The animal was killed by a [[Sarlacc/Legends|sarlacc]] in [[The Rumbles]].

==Biography==
Snit was a mountain dewback trained by Kallie Calwell in [[Pika Oasis/Legends|Pika Oasis]]. In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] while he was being ridden by Kallie he stampeded towards the Rumbles and the sarlacc in the area. He fell into the sarlacc once [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] saved Kallie and [[Annileen Calwell]] from the creature's back.
